scope: Read-only review of final runtime002 executor, saved results, actual per-arm traces and producer-only supplemental diagnostic. This is not proof of Python refinement or an independent numerical implementation.

findings.assessment: B receives the same context, coupling candidates, protected frame validation and original checks. It memoizes local feature extraction by exact context/matrix and primitive predicates by operation/field/bound/value; it recurses through the conjunction and shares repeated atomic checks. This is a realistic strong content/dependency cache for the bounded workload, not a deliberately naive full-recomputation comparator.

Unlike runtime001 oracle-derived reference traces, runtime002 executes B and PPG separately through the common proposal helper, performs accept/rollback updates, and checks their outcomes and omitted positions against the saved full-family oracle. The archived previous executor and TRACE_REVISION preserve the distinction. Proposal order is constructed, not a measured physical-controller change sequence.

Scopes are exact only over the explicitly declared five-state bank per CSV context. Source and target bank membership are re-established for PPG decisions. Neither finite completeness nor the formal theorem establishes closure of arbitrary raw couplings, arbitrary proposed feature states or changed physical controller parameters.

Required positions are prior failures union semantic scope; only prior PASS positions outside that scope are omitted. No failure is repaired merely by an empty hazard. Fresh full checker validation observed no wrong acceptances or wrong PPG omissions on this finite cohort. This is observed finite correctness, not a universal Python/source correspondence proof.

The label is historical and must not be interpreted as an isolated algebra-removal experiment. It both disables hazard use and clears the primitive atom cache per proposal, retains feature caching, and uses precomputed GEN/dataset values. NO_HAZARD also pays unused PPG preparation and is diagnostic rather than an optimized competing controller. Neither original ablation isolates protected-view producer reuse.

The separately planned supplemental diagnostic changes only reuse of signed GEN and the dataset hash on unchanged prepared CSV frames; all local coupling snapshots are reused from runtime002. It compares one protected computation per CSV (8 calls) with recomputation per proposal (160 calls), checks produced values against the same bank and obtains identical 160 decisions and 28 accepts. Ordinary dependency caching can obtain exactly this reuse. It is not a proof-removal ablation or full end-to-end speed comparison.
findings.timing_limit: One fixed arm order, prepared pandas frames, no repeated paired timing; not a robust performance estimate.

findings.assessment: Cold policy totals include each arm preparation plus proposal pass; warm reuses the same Engine caches in one process and is not a cold-process or cold-machine comparison. PPG full-bank truth/scope preparation is counted. Common data/coupling/oracle preparation and fresh validation are reported separately. New Lean elaboration cost is measured and added to the cold advantage comparison; inherited framework development/setup remains historical and unmeasured, not zero. Trace overhead is not a separately measured net-saving benchmark.

The aggressive retained-PASS rule is a deliberately unsafe negative control, not stock testmon or a named practical baseline. The malformed-value and protected-change controls exercise low-level frame/rational admission checks, not full end-to-end malformed-proposal runs.

The separate Lean model proves protected projection Fixed/Stable and finite-domain preservation/acceptance rules. This review does not widen it to Python numerical producers, arbitrary raw-feature update stability, physical controller repairs, Nanoda verification of the new theorem, or semantic completeness of CSV observations.

supported_conclusion: Hazard and a protected observable can be used deterministically without MT on this explicitly finite coupling-replacement workload. The PPG policy safely omits old PASS positions outside the exact finite hazard; the strong ordinary memoizing baseline reaches the same decisions and is faster here. Protected producer reuse saves recomputation relative to deliberate recomputation, equally available to an ordinary dependency cache.
unsupported_claims: practical superiority over the strong baseline
checks: Reviewed source differences and artifacts only; verified receipt source hashes, per-arm trace decision agreement and supplemental decision equality. No runtime execution, source mutation or new performance experiment.
